description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointed Mr. N. M. P. P. K. K. Nawarathne and 08 Persons as the members for the Constitution of an Industrial Court
categorisation: This gazette content involves the appointment of specific named individuals (e.g., Mr. N. M. P. P. K. K. Nawarathna, Dr. R. K. Silva, etc.) as members of a panel for the constitution of an Industrial Court under the Industrial Disputes Act. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters as it pertains to the appointment of legal professionals to a judicial/quasi-judicial body responsible for industrial dispute resolution, making it Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) rather than a government personnel gazette.
